_doc: Out-of-warranty maintenance multiplier (maint_oow_per_year / maint_in_per_year), keyed by make then powertrain_type. Used ONLY as the default when a vehicle omits maint_oow_per_year. An explicit maint_oow_per_year on a vehicle ALWAYS wins — use it for per-vehicle age/km premiums (e.g. an old high-km vehicle in an otherwise-reliable brand). Family-agnostic; mirrors docs/brand_repair_tail.md. BC/Canada market, +/-0.5x uncertainty on absolutes; the relative ordering is the load-bearing part.
